reasoning_content: Xvfb is running on :99. Next, I'll launch the `pomodoro` console command on the virtual display, run it in the background, wait a few seconds, and check whether the process is still alive (i.e., not crashed). Also, to check whether the Qt window actually rendered, I'll take a screenshot with x11vnc's screenshot functionality (xwd) or a similar tool. x11vnc has a `-screenshot` option: `x11vnc -display :99 -screenshot /tmp/pomodoro.png -nopw` — yes, x11vnc supports `-screenshot file -o -`. Let's try that.

action.command: cd /workspace && DISPLAY=:99 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb ./.venv/bin/pomodoro >/tmp/pomodoro.log 2>&1 & APP_PID=$!; sleep 12; if kill -0 $APP_PID 2>/dev/null; then echo "RUNNING pid=$APP_PID"; else echo "DEAD"; fi; ps aux | grep -E "venv/bin/pomodoro" | grep -v grep; echo ---; cat /tmp/pomodoro.log
